schema_title: Krytronx Quantum K-Field Topic and Keyword Index

repository_snapshot.index_scope: Current public repository root metadata, README, CITATION.cff, licenses, directory names, filenames, paired PDF/JSON artifacts, machine-readable companions, source archives, lecture files, commentary records, and typed graphs.
repository_snapshot.normalization_note: Epoch suffixes, file extensions, separators, version markers, and duplicated PDF/JSON representations are normalized for topic extraction, while exact observed paths remain preserved in artifact_index.

sources: GitHub recursive tree and directory listings on the current main branch
paired PDF and JSON artifact names
artifact_grouping_rules: Treat paired PDF and JSON files with the same stem as representations of one research artifact.
Preserve every observed file path in artifact_index.
Strip a trailing ten-digit epoch only for normalized-title and keyword extraction.
Strip v1/v2/v3 markers only for normalized-title and keyword extraction.
Treat underscore, hyphen, slash, and whitespace as equivalent token separators.
Case-fold for indexing while preserving original filename case.
Resolve known archive misspellings through spelling_correction_index.
limitations: Index is based on public repository metadata and machine-readable text available in the archive snapshot.
PDF body text was not re-extracted; topics are derived from repository metadata, README/CFF text, filenames, and selected JSON records.
Terms appearing only inside binary ZIP contents or only inside unparsed PDF body text may require a later full-content indexing pass.
